findings.fix: Move them to `LieAlgebra.Orthogonal.typeD` and name them `apply_inr_inr`, `apply_inl_inr`, and `apply_inr_inl`; update in-repository uses without compatibility aliases.
findings.issue: `typeD_apply_inr_inr`, `typeD_apply_inl_inr` (line 76), and `typeD_apply_inr_inl` (line 92) take the existing Mathlib type `LieAlgebra.Orthogonal.typeD` as their first explicit argument but are declared in `TauCeti`, preventing the canonical receiver-namespace API and dot notation.

summary: The three structural entry lemmas remain outside the namespace of their existing Mathlib receiver type; the contested repository-wide namespace constraint is absent from the checkout and would not override this rubric’s explicit type-namespace rule.
